interpretation: Passive spatial and temporal evidence left 80% of BAM truths non-unique.
The complete orthogonal intervention signatures were unique for all 40 candidate BAM worlds.
A truth-blind greedy selector reached the exact complete-signature equivalence class in every truth case and identified all 40 truths.
No true world was eliminated and every intervention sequence contracted monotonically.
The result is an idealized experimental-identifiability upper bound, not a claim that these manipulations are equally feasible in field ecology.
